text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One evening, while passing through the shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Seems pretty lively over there, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hey you two, looking all close over there!
Care to give it a try~?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa, they're doing a lottery raffle...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, are you sure!?
Then right away...!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, before that, I need to get the raffle tickets!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Apparently you get them
if you do your shopping in the commercial district...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we use the single prize
to buy something delicious to eat? Ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And so, I got one lottery ticket.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
We only have one chance...!
Let's do our best, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying our prayers together,
we gripped the lever side by side and spun the raffle wheel.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result is—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Whaaaaaaaat!?
You've gotta be kidding!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Umm... Trainer.
What should we do with this hot springs trip ticket...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehh?! But Trainer, you won it with me...
choice_data_list: Go ahead and take whoever wants to go with you.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: With the person I want to go with...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Understood. But could you hold onto it
for a little while, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Right now doesn't really feel like the time to relax at a hot spring...
There are just so many things I need to work hard on."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Once you finish everything properly,
I'll give it back to you then!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
...That's a promise, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I ended up holding onto the hot spring trip ticket
given to me by Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Waaahhh~!!
That hamburger steak looks so juicy...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The carrots are so glossy and shiny, too...
This is definitely going to make your cheeks melt!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hamburg steak, huh? Brings back memories...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
On nights after a really tough day in the fields,
or after shoveling snow all day long,
Mom used to make this for me all the time.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
We used to talk about how eating when you're utterly exhausted
and starving makes the food taste unrealistically good—
choice_data_list: So it's a taste filled with memories.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
It's a memory of me and Mama...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer!
You simply have to share this hamburg steak with me!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I want to make sweet, cheek-melting memories
together with you♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...That night, Special Week and I both
held our cheeks in pure bliss over the delicious food.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Aaah, I really wanted to eat that 1st-prize special carrot hamburg steak...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But come to think of it,
I got plenty of ingredients like this, so—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: We can just make them ourselves, right? Hamburg steaks, that is!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Right! All right, now that that's settled,
let's go buy more ingredients right away!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe.
I wonder how many hamburger steaks we can make~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing the shopping, I headed home with her,
making sure to tell her not to eat it all in one day.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
J-Just one...!
A mountain-high premium hamburger steak meal...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Haa... But still, it's better than not being able to eat it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah, gotta stay positive...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'll cherish this single carrot and enjoy every extraordinarily delicious bite!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Special Week felt a tiny bit
cheered up, if only by the worth of a single carrot.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Aaah...!
No waaaay...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hauu... I really wanted to win something~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with Special Week,
I slumped down in sheer dejection...
